name: Voxel Carving
definition: A technique to carve a voxel grid from a number of depth maps or silhouettes. It creates a dense, filled voxel grid of the given shape, unlike surface-only voxelization.
summary: Voxel Carving creates a dense, filled voxel grid by intersecting viewing frustums from multiple cameras, producing an explicit volumetric representation rather than a boundary surface.
